title: Add Premium upsell interstitial when free user hits contact limit — revenue/monetization

Include pricing ($9/mo) and a CTA button linking to /dashboard/billing. Track contact_limit_upsell_shown and contact_limit_upsell_clicked in PostHog. Acceptance: modal shows at limit, CTA works, analytics fire, and tests cover the limit-gate + upsell flow.
